<cite ref="Chagigah 3a:4">Ḥag. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מניידי … ומְרַחֲשִׁין שפוותייהו</he> (mutes) nodded their heads and moved their lips.—Part. pass. <he>מְרַחַשׁ</he>; f. <cite ref="M01763"><he>מְרַחְשָׁא</he></cite>; pl. f. <he>מְרַחְשָׁן</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:19">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>חזא דקא מר׳ שפוותה</he> (not <he>שפוותיה</he>) he saw that her lips were moving (she was mumbling a charm).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 90b:11">Ib. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא רַחוּשֵׁי מר׳ שפוותייהו בעלמא</he> (not <he>שפוותיה</he>) perhaps only their lips moved (in the grave)?, v. <cite ref="T00540">preced.</cite>; (Ms. F. <he>מְרַחֲשִׁין וכ׳</he> they moved their lips).
<cite ref="Menachot 63a:2">Men. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>כדאמרי אינשי קמרחשן וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>הוה מר׳ וכ׳</he>) as people say, his lips are moving (he is excited).

senses.gloss: to be brought about, to occur. א׳ ניסא a miracle happened.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:1">Targ. Ps. XVIII, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 4:13">Targ. Koh. IV, 13</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106a:15">B. Mets. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>אי הוות חזית לאִתְרַחוּשֵׁי לך ניסא הוה א׳ וכ׳</he> if thou wert worthy of a miracle to happen to thee, a miracle would have happened to thee like that &c.
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:8">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>לא בכל … מִתְרְחִישׁ ניסא</he> not always does a miracle happen.
